title: Retaining a lifting equation under posetal replacement
statement: Let V:J→Cᵒᵖ be indexed by a nonempty partial order, and S:M→Cᵒᵖ by a directed preorder. Suppose e:J↪oM and h:V=e⋙S define a refinement, the images of two given P-colimit classes are distinct, and a given Q-colimit class from V is the image of z∈colim(S⋙R) under a natural transformation q:R→Q. There exists a nonempty directed partial-order refinement U:N→Cᵒᵖ of V, with N in the same index universe, in which the two images remain distinct and the Q-class still lifts to colim(U⋙R). Canonical maps are those of [def-trf-point-system-refinement-map].

source.place: Tag 00YP, proof of lemma-refine-all-at-once; strict refinements preceding Tag 00YO

proof.text: Choose the posetal replacement r:N↪oM and d:J↪oN fixing e, and restrict S along r. The composite refinement map from V through N is the original map into M. Equality of the two classes in N would imply equality in M, so separation holds.

source.place: Tag 00YP, proof of lemma-refine-all-at-once; strict refinements preceding Tag 00YO

proof.text: The embedding r is cofinal since each i is ≤ an equivalent representative. Thus colimit.pre along r is an isomorphism. Take the inverse image z′ of z. Naturality of refinement maps with q, together with the composition formula, gives the desired equation after the isomorphism on Q-colimits; its injectivity gives the equation already over N.
